title: PLTR-AWARE: which product does the stem need?

questions.ask: Must data come in from an outside system?
questions.yes: Data Connection (REST APIs through an external transform)

questions.ask: Must it be cleaned, joined or split?
Must people decide and record the decision?
questions.yes: A Workshop app whose buttons run actions

questions.ask: Does a process move through states and get stuck?
Should something happen on a condition or a schedule?

otherwise: Analysis only: Contour for tables at scale, Quiver for objects and time series
before: Part 1: which product for which need
caption: Put the need on the map first, then pick the product; the first question answered yes usually names the right option.
alt: Decision ladder: outside data to Data Connection, cleaning to Pipeline Builder, decisions to Workshop with actions, stuck processes to Machinery, conditions to Automate, otherwise Contour or Quiver.
